subject: What's new in A Fish in the Kitchen
heading: What's new
paragraphs: A short note from me — the latest update is out, and a few things you told us about are fixed.

A shopping list that makes sense. Add a few recipes and the same food now lands on one line — eggs from three dishes read as “Egg · 6”, with each recipe's amount underneath. One tick and they're all in the trolley.
Cook Mode shows what each step needs. Every step lists the ingredients it actually uses, with the amounts, so there's no scrolling back to the list with floury hands.
No more surprise waiting. Recipes can now show chilling, resting and proving time, and it counts in the total — so a tart that needs three hours in the fridge doesn't look like an 80-minute job.
Bring your family in. Anyone in a cookbook can now ask the owner to add someone, and there's a home-screen widget with this week's recipe.

What should we do next? Reply to this email — it comes straight to me.
— Dylan
